body:
The source implementation is in PR #818; local format/lint and all3,466unit tests pass. Actual-source materialization and independent verification reproduce every quantity/reference entry. CI is still running; source release and the endpoint-specific training recipe remain pending.

A structural audit found a systematic S4(e) annotation discrepancy, and a prespecified mass check resolves which sequence representation is supported:

| Block | Rows | Full literal sequence matches reported mass | Removing first residue matches mass | Reported length equals full length minus1 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| DC database search |1581|1581|0|1581|
| DC spectral-library search |1020|1020|0|1020|

Masses include explicit inline modification deltas; tolerance0.1Da accommodates rounded source deltas. Installed Pyteomics and Biopython independently agree on unmodified monoisotopic masses within0.002Da. Original deposited identification alternatives also contain729/1008of the full literal strings. Neither mass agreement nor a shared deposited sequence proves an exact quantity/acquisition identity, but the evidence does not support shortening the peptide strings to satisfy the reported Length field.

Most supported DC parent occurrences start one residue before source Start and end at source End. Preserve the original length/coordinate discrepancy; a future recipe should derive positions from exact sequence occurrences while retaining all reference alternatives and the source claims. Do not silently filter every DC row merely because its reported length disagrees.

Full-label matching also initially produced zero reference joins because sources spell accessions as `sp|accession|name`, `accession|name`, or bare `accession`. A separate declared token-normalization audit preserves original labels and finds candidate parent sequences for1,612human rows,875DC database rows and941DC library rows, spanning186/196/191distinct parent sequences respectively. These are candidate mappings, not measured origins; missing deposited references remain missing, and no current external sequence substitutions were made.

Source and per-row forensic evidence: [Presto1903report](https://github.com/pirl-unc/presto/blob/codex/modular-presto-model-20261020/experiments/2026-10-24_1903_codex_lymph-canonical-admission/README.md). No source quantities, model targets, cohort thresholds or predictions were changed. This is progress toward a defensible recipe, not a biological accuracy result.

Original Nanaware2024 human native-lymph and mouse DC I-Ab measurements can now be queried through the shared EvidenceStore. The source keeps separate algorithm blocks, peptide forms, raw quantity cells, deposited parent-reference alternatives and explicit sample/context uncertainties; it does not create a training cohort or infer intracellular concentrations.

The pinned source includes19original assets,4,384feature rows,32,995measurement cells,3,430deposited protein-reference entries and23,455identification alternatives. Independent original XML decoding reproduces121,346source cells and every quantity/reference/identification entry. Typed assertions preserve DC expansion treatment, unresolved replicate/control correspondence, the human instrument conflict, and analytical-digest versus native-peptide distinctions.

Validation:

- `./format.sh` and `./lint.sh` pass.
- `./test.sh`:3,466passed locally with one worker;43focused source/catalog tests also pass.
- Actual canonical materialization and independent source replay pass,15.2s/0.46GiB and2.3s/0.56GiB respectively.
- Original hashes, header drift, duplicate forms/search outputs, missing versus zero values, unsupported/formula quantities and tampering are checked.

Version2.0.27; package schema24/catalog29. Existing package identities remain unchanged. This is source evidence only: endpoint-specific aggregation, accession normalization/occurrence resolution, confidence policy and prospective training splits remain follow-up work. Raw source lengths and coordinates remain uncorrected source claims.

Refs #817. Reproduction and source audit: [Presto canonical-admission report](https://github.com/pirl-unc/presto/blob/codex/modular-presto-model-20261020/experiments/2026-10-24_1903_codex_lymph-canonical-admission/README.md).
